items.Sentence: Influent enters the headworks of the Facility and is processed through macerators (i.e., channel grinders)
Wastewater is then conveyed to the secondary treatment system, which consists of two 370,000-gallon aeration basins
secondary treatment system, which consists of two 370,000-gallon aeration basins, four rectangular clarifiers
chlorination in two chlorine contact chambers with sodium hypochlorite
dechlorination in an effluent channel with sodium bisulfite
The system operates by sending disinfected secondary effluent water to an ultrafiltration membrane followed by a reverse osmosis membrane
ultrafiltration membrane followed by a reverse osmosis membrane to reduce total dissolved solids
A side stream rotary micro screening process removes rags and foreign materials from the tank
WAS being pumped to the DAFT. Thickened sludge is then pumped to an aerobic digester
Thickened sludge is then pumped to an aerobic digester
Sludge from the aerobic digesters is dewatered using a belt press
biosolids are stockpiled in holding bins prior to disposal by composting facility
